@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+**CamCraft {{VERSION}}** - a clean-room CAM system that turns 3D models into
+NC programs for CNC milling and turning.
+
+- **Full history:** [CHANGELOG.md]({{REPO_URL}}/blob/{{TAG}}/CHANGELOG.md)
+- **Roadmap:** the [open issues]({{REPO_URL}}/issues) are the current roadmap
+- **Questions:** ask on [Discord](https://solidcraft.io/discord)
+
+## What's in this release
+
+{{NOTES}}
+
+## Report a bug or ask for a feature
+
+- **Found a bug?** [Open a bug report]({{REPO_URL}}/issues/new/choose): a
+  toolpath that looks wrong, a crash, or a refusal you think is mistaken.
+- **Want a feature or an enhancement?** [Request it]({{REPO_URL}}/issues/new/choose):
+  say what you are trying to machine and what is in the way.
+- **Not sure?** Ask on [Discord](https://solidcraft.io/discord) first.
+
+## Thanks
+
+Thank you to everyone who contributed to this release:
+
+{{CONTRIBUTORS}}

@@ -246,9 +246,18 @@ jobs:
       # keeps every release, newest first, separated by a line "---"; the
       # body is its first section (user, 2026-11-07: "just what is in that
       # specific release").
-      - name: Release notes for this version only
+      # The release page is .github/RELEASE_TEMPLATE.md filled in: this
+      # version's section of RELEASE_NOTES.md (never the whole history), the
+      # links (CHANGELOG, issues as the roadmap, Discord, bug and feature
+      # reports) and a thank-you list of the GitHub authors of every commit
+      # since the previous release tag (user, 2026-11-07).
+      - name: Release page from the template
         if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
         shell: pwsh
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+          TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
+          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
         run: |
           $lines = @(Get-Content RELEASE_NOTES.md | ForEach-Object { $_.TrimEnd() })
           $end = [Array]::IndexOf($lines, '---')
@@ -258,7 +267,41 @@ jobs:
           if ($head -notmatch [regex]::Escape($env:CAMCRAFT_VERSION)) {
             throw "RELEASE_NOTES.md's first section is '$head', not $env:CAMCRAFT_VERSION - update the notes before tagging"
           }
-          $lines[0..($end - 1)] | Set-Content -Encoding utf8 dist/release-body.md
+          # The section without its own '# CamCraft X.Y.Z' title line (the
+          # template names the version) and without trailing blank lines.
+          $notes = @($lines[1..($end - 1)])
+          $notes = ($notes -join "`n").Trim()
+          if (-not $notes) { throw "RELEASE_NOTES.md's $env:CAMCRAFT_VERSION section is empty" }
+
+          # Contributors: the GitHub login of every commit author since the
+          # previous release tag (the highest vX.Y.Z below this one).
+          $cur = [version]($env:TAG.TrimStart('v'))
+          $prev = gh api "repos/$env:REPO/tags" --paginate --jq '.[].name' |
+            Where-Object { $_ -match '^v\d+\.\d+\.\d+$' } |
+            Where-Object { [version]($_.TrimStart('v')) -lt $cur } |
+            Sort-Object { [version]($_.TrimStart('v')) } | Select-Object -Last 1
+          $logins = @()
+          if ($prev) {
+            $logins = @(gh api "repos/$env:REPO/compare/$prev...$env:TAG" --paginate `
+              --jq '.commits[] | .author.login // empty')
+          }
+          $logins = @($logins | Where-Object { $_ -and $_ -notmatch '\[bot\]$' } | Sort-Object -Unique)
+          $thanks = if ($logins.Count -gt 0) {
+            ($logins | ForEach-Object { "- @$_" }) -join "`n"
+          } else {
+            "- everyone who reported, tested and discussed on the issues and on Discord"
+          }
+
+          $body = Get-Content -Raw .github/RELEASE_TEMPLATE.md
+          foreach ($k in '{{VERSION}}', '{{TAG}}', '{{REPO_URL}}', '{{NOTES}}', '{{CONTRIBUTORS}}') {
+            if (-not $body.Contains($k)) { throw ".github/RELEASE_TEMPLATE.md lost its $k placeholder" }
+          }
+          $body = $body.Replace('{{VERSION}}', $env:CAMCRAFT_VERSION)
+          $body = $body.Replace('{{TAG}}', $env:TAG)
+          $body = $body.Replace('{{REPO_URL}}', "https://github.com/$env:REPO")
+          $body = $body.Replace('{{NOTES}}', $notes)
+          $body = $body.Replace('{{CONTRIBUTORS}}', $thanks)
+          Set-Content -Encoding utf8 -NoNewline dist/release-body.md -Value $body
           Get-Content dist/release-body.md
       - name: Publish GitHub Release
         if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
